currentState: The AIsle platform is built on a modern Next.js 15 App Router and React 19 stack, utilizing Prisma 7 with PostgreSQL for data management and Supabase Auth for authentication. The platform shows a significant number of posts but very low recent comment activity and no new user signups in the last 7 days.
